C0596.title: State-Owned Enterprise Employee Coerced into Espionage Abroad, Leaking Classified Information
C0596.summary: China's Ministry of State Security disclosed that Li Si, an employee in a critical position at a state-owned enterprise, was targeted and coerced by a spy agency during an overseas inspection due to personal misconduct, resulting in the immediate handover of classified information. The incident highlights the risk of trade secret leakage through personal behavior-related coercion.
